items.briefing:
Australian organisations are being urged to think about "minimum viable operations" — having a clear plan for which critical functions must keep running if systems go down due to a cyberattack or outage. Separately, managed service providers supporting Microsoft 365 users are flagging readiness gaps as AI tools become more widely adopted, meaning some organisations may not have adequate security controls in place as they expand their use of AI-powered features.

**Practical tip:** Review whether your organisation has a documented list of the most critical tasks and systems needed to keep operating during an outage — even a simple one-page plan can significantly speed up recovery.

featured.title: Minimum viable company: Recover faster when systems go dark
featured.summary: Focusing on the right systems first can cut recovery time and help firms avoid reintroducing risk after a cyber attack.
